created.description: an ISO8601 representation of the date and time this review was created (using host's timezone)

agent.description: a string representation of agent and model: `${agent}/${model}`

parent_scope.description: the parent of the parent directory (typically something like "reviews", "features", etc.)

scope.description: the parent directory in which this review was saved (_this typically helps to scope the review_)

baseline.description: the review file (_including the parent directory for scoping purposes_)

implemented.description: whether the suggestions in this review have been implemented

follow_up_review.description: the filename of the review that followed _this_ review to validate whether the suggestions here we actually implemented
